summary: Mobile-only parity sweep for the rebuilt Provider Switch (5-step walkthrough), Documents PageIntro, and Compare Providers PageIntro. All flows verified end-to-end in light and dark mode. Login as cathy@example.com → routes /provider-switch, /documents, /compare-providers all render correctly. Provider Switch: stepper renders all 5 steps with correct labels and testIDs (switch-step-1..5, switch-stepper); on load the screen resumed at Step 2 because a saved draft with stage='comparing' already existed (expected behaviour, confirms draft persistence across sessions). Step 1 shows the switch-next button (draft exists) instead of switch-start — clicking it advanced to Step 2. Step 2 BYD radio pills (switch-byd-<key>-yes/no/na) toggle. Step 3 compare topics (switch-compare-<key>) toggle strike-through. Step 4: switch-last-day='2026-08-15' + switch-reason-short='moving closer to home' → switch-letter-preview updates live to contain '15/08/2026' and the short reason; switch-letter-copy and switch-letter-download (.txt) are present. Step 5: switch-complete is aria-disabled until all 4 switch-handover-<key> checks are ticked, then becomes enabled. Documents renders the required PageIntro (eyebrow 'Document Vault' + title 'All Your Aged-Care Paperwork, in One Place') above the document list; documents use FINANCIAL badges and no doubled '$$' anywhere. Compare Providers renders the required PageIntro (eyebrow 'Compare Providers' + title 'Side-by-Side Quality Context') above the ranking card (BlueBerry Care 4.0 · 1 rating). Dark-mode spot-check (settings → theme-dark) confirmed all three screens are readable — no white-on-white, no dark-on-dark, badges, stepper, and letter preview all keep contrast. No $$ regressions found on any of the three routes.
critical_code_review_comments: provider-switch.tsx setStep via chip clicks does not persist stage — only saveAndAdvance (Next button) does. This matches the web flow but be aware jumping steps via the stepper is a local-only view change; the persisted resume stage reflects the last 'Next' press. If web allows chip-click to persist, this would be a parity gap (not verified in this run — flagged for information only).

provider-switch.tsx uses navigator.clipboard.writeText inside copyLetter but does not surface the fallback error path when Share.share is unavailable on web. Low priority — Copy still works on Expo web preview.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing saved provider-switch draft (stage='comparing') which naturally resumed the flow at Step 2, confirming persistence.
